answer: Each identity posts a 50-unit stake an insurer holds: when a jury finds an answer copied, the stake pays the graders and the identity's weight falls to zero until it posts a fresh one. Every answer is checked for an echo in the author's last 20 answers, and a verbatim repeat triggers the same forfeit. Each answer must exceed a sonnet's 14 lines to state its stake. One sable pelt is held in escrow per identity, returned after 10 clean epochs; a caught fake forfeits pelt and stake. One fake costs one stake and one pelt; 100 fakes cost 100 each.
